summary: The non_gaia system uses CrewAI and provides the most complete functional coverage of all three implementations, with dedicated agents for all 13 requirements including real logic for vaccination scheduling, task prioritization, fair rotation, emergency handling, and adoption management. However, a fundamental architectural flaw prevents any agent from being instantiated: every agent passes `database=database` as a keyword argument to CrewAI's Agent.__init__(), which does not accept that parameter, causing a TypeError on every agent construction. Additional runtime errors — missing Database methods, missing timedelta imports, and missing subdirectory creation — compound the problem. The functional design is strong, but the system cannot execute as written.

findings.description: All 11 agents pass `database=database` as a keyword argument to crewai.Agent.__init__(). CrewAI's Agent class does not accept a `database` parameter, causing TypeError on every agent instantiation. The entire system fails before any domain logic executes.
findings.evidence: animal_registry_agent.py:11-19: super().__init__(..., database=database); identical pattern in all 11 agent files: staff_management_agent.py, task_generation_agent.py, task_assignment_agent.py, calendar_agent.py, cleaning_agent.py, admission_agent.py, priority_agent.py, rotation_agent.py, emergency_agent.py, adoption_agent.py

findings.description: Database.__init__ creates only the top-level 'data/' directory. All save methods write into subdirectories (data/animals/, data/staff/, data/tasks/, data/cleaning_tasks/, data/adoption_processes/, data/emergencies/, data/vaccination_schedules/, data/task_assignments/) that are never created, causing FileNotFoundError on the first save call.
findings.evidence: database.py:8-13: os.makedirs(db_path, exist_ok=True) creates only 'data/'; save_animal at line 13: open(f'{self.db_path}/animals/{animal.id}.json', 'w') — subdirectory 'data/animals/' does not exist

findings.description: Database class is missing get_all_vaccination_schedules() and get_all_task_assignments() methods. CalendarAgent, RotationAgent, EmergencyAgent, and TaskAssignmentAgent all call these non-existent methods, raising AttributeError.
findings.evidence: calendar_agent.py:55: self.database.get_all_vaccination_schedules(); rotation_agent.py:31: self.database.get_all_task_assignments(); emergency_agent.py:102: self.database.get_all_task_assignments(); task_assignment_agent.py:167: self.database.get_all_task_assignments()

findings.description: admission_agent.py and emergency_agent.py both use timedelta() but only import datetime from the datetime module, causing NameError at runtime on any admission or emergency task creation.
findings.evidence: admission_agent.py:4: from datetime import datetime (no timedelta); line 94: deadline=datetime.now() + timedelta(hours=24); emergency_agent.py:4: from datetime import datetime (no timedelta); line 63: deadline=datetime.now() + timedelta(hours=2)

findings.description: animal_shelter_system.py instantiates AnimalShelterSystem() at module scope (line 278), before the `if __name__ == '__main__'` guard. This causes full system initialization — including all agent constructions — on every import, not just direct execution.
findings.evidence: animal_shelter_system.py:278: system = AnimalShelterSystem() at module scope, outside any function or conditional guard

findings.description: AnimalRegistryAgent.update_animal() builds the history_entry dict after the for-loop over updates.items(), using the last loop variable values for 'key' and 'old_value'. Multi-field updates produce a single history entry recording only the last field changed.
findings.evidence: animal_registry_agent.py:41-58: for key, value in updates.items(): setattr(...) — then history_entry = {'field': key, 'old_value': getattr(animal, key), ...} built outside the loop with stale loop variables

findings.description: Agents coordinate exclusively through shared Database file I/O rather than agent-to-agent messaging. CrewAI agents configured with tools=[] and allow_delegation=False behave as plain Python objects with no reactive, event-driven, or emergent multi-agent behavior.
findings.evidence: All 11 agents: tools=[], allow_delegation=False in super().__init__(); all inter-agent coordination flows via self.database.* calls with no direct messaging between agents

findings.description: Model classes (Animal, StaffMember, Task, TaskAssignment, VaccinationSchedule, CleaningTask, AdoptionProcess, EmergencyEvent) are defined both in animal_shelter_system.py (lines 20-97) and in models/animal_model.py. Agents import from models.animal_model, creating two separate class hierarchies that are not interchangeable.
findings.evidence: animal_shelter_system.py:20: class Animal(BaseModel); models/animal_model.py:6: class Animal(BaseModel) — identical structure but distinct Python class objects

findings.description: All 13 requirements have dedicated agent implementations with real business logic: CalendarAgent for vaccination scheduling with overdue detection, PriorityAgent for deadline-based urgency calculation, RotationAgent for variance-based workload balancing, EmergencyAgent for staff-absence reconfiguration, and AdoptionAgent for the full application-to-finalization lifecycle.
findings.evidence: priority_agent.py:21-33: calculate_task_priority with deadline-based urgency logic; rotation_agent.py:51-68: _calculate_balance_score using statistical variance; adoption_agent.py: submit, review, approve, reject, finalize methods

logical_inconsistencies: CrewAI Agent subclasses pass unsupported `database` kwarg to super().__init__(), making all agents uninstantiable with TypeError

Database subdirectories (animals/, staff/, tasks/, cleaning_tasks/, adoption_processes/, emergencies/, vaccination_schedules/, task_assignments/) are never created, causing FileNotFoundError on first write
get_all_vaccination_schedules() and get_all_task_assignments() methods are absent from Database despite being called by 4 agents
Model classes defined in two separate files (animal_shelter_system.py and models/animal_model.py) with no shared import, creating type incompatibility
Module-level AnimalShelterSystem() instantiation runs initialization side-effects on any import of the file
implementation_risks: TypeError on agent instantiation prevents the entire system from starting — all agents fail before any logic runs
FileNotFoundError on first database write would halt any operation involving animal, staff, or task persistence
AttributeError from missing Database methods crashes CalendarAgent, RotationAgent, EmergencyAgent, and TaskAssignmentAgent
NameError from missing timedelta import causes AdmissionAgent and EmergencyAgent task creation to fail at runtime
History tracking bug in update_animal() silently produces incorrect audit logs for multi-field updates
